_meta.name: Santali grammar stub (seed v0)
_meta.description: Minimal grammar layer for the Santali target pack. Santali (Munda family) is SOV like Warli, so the reorderer applies. Inflection/postposition maps are intentionally EMPTY for v0 — English function words are dropped so they never leak into Ol Chiki output; unmatched words pass through flagged. Expand with speaker-reviewed rules over time.
